verdicts.reason: Both break the logo/product lockup. The cream circle has come loose from the can and is cropped at the bottom-left edge, so the can now reads as a faint orange outline against the orange background. A at least fills the canvas: the headline and the Try It CTA are big and clearly lead, though "Out now." has turned dark (it was white) and sits low and apart from the headline. B shrinks the headline, subline and CTA to small sizes floating in large dead orange areas, so the text is weak at this size and the layout looks like a scaled-down copy, not a redesign.
